svg.title: Learning designer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as learning designer, wearing a plain work shirt. Visible work cue: A three-milestone learning path sits above an open lesson book, linking course design with educational content. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face and round glasses.
